name: Lexa
beschreibung: The Gasthof Lexa is located on Arlbergstraße in the center of St. Anton am Arlberg. The surroundings are characterized by their proximity to the pedestrian zone and the valley stations of the Galzigbahn and Rendlbahn. The inn's amenities include a traditional, wood-paneled dining room as well as modern guest rooms with a sauna area.
